description: Jingle with the christmas palette (red, green, white), brightness 100. Notes start at 0, 600, 1200, 2400, 3000, 3600, 4800, 5400, 6000, 6600 and 7200 ms of a 12 s cycle; note k of cycle c takes color (11 c + k) mod 3. Each rises from 300 to full in 60 ms (650 at 30 ms) and decays toward 300 with a time constant of 0.35 of its length (480.18 at 630 ms of the 1,200 ms note). The long note decays through the rest: 343.18 at 9.6 s, 302.51 at 11.99 s.
